title: Notify the Food Authority or local council of a food business
summary: Learn the requirements and process for notifying the appropriate authority (local council or NSW Food Authority) before starting a food business.

faqs.q: Do I need to notify an authority before starting a food business?
faqs.a: Yes, if your business sells food, you must notify either your local council or the NSW Food Authority before you start.

faqs.q: When do I need to notify my local council?
faqs.a: You need to notify your local council if your business sells or serves food directly to consumers.

faqs.q: When do I need to notify the NSW Food Authority?
faqs.a: You need to notify the NSW Food Authority if your business is in an area not governed by a local council, or if your business is a food producer or transporter.
